Add data science to your Latin American Studies toolkit. Working with real Brazilian datasets on product authentication, food security, forensics, and social issues, you will learn methods that apply across Latin America. After this course, you will be able to use AI to analyze real data on Latin American questions, build predictive models and explain them in plain language, and assess the ethics and social impact of AI. No coding skills required!!
